u0: Episode start. The agent has not yet seen the matching key. Current objective: explore the rooms, especially the three left-column rooms, and get a clear view of the key without walls or closed doors hiding it; opening closed unlocked doors is fine. Losing or not holding the key is irrelevant here — only the first sighting advances progress. Once the key is seen, transition to u1.
u1: The matching key has been located but is not yet carried. Current objective: navigate to the key's cell, face it, and pick it up. Closed unlocked doors may need toggling along the way. When the key is in hand (key_found remains latched and has_matching_key becomes true), transition to u2; otherwise stay in u1 and keep working toward the key.
u2: The agent holds the matching key and must now open the locked door guarding the target room. Current objective: reach the locked door in the right-column target room's left wall and toggle it open. If the key is dropped, has_matching_key turns false and the agent must retrieve the key again (state remains u2 until the door is open and the key is still held). When the locked door is open, transition to u3.
u3: The locked target door is open and the agent still holds the key. Current objective: step through the doorway into the target room — the doorway cell counts as entered. The key must be dropped before the ball can be picked up, so dropping it inside or at the doorway is part of progress; do not shut the door. When the agent stands on the doorway or inside the target room, transition to u4.
u4: The agent has entered the target room. Current objective: ensure hands are empty (drop the key if still carried) and pick up the mission's ball, which lies in this room. Avoid toggling the target door shut. When the ball is picked up, transition to the final state u5; otherwise remain in u4 and search the room.
u5: Terminal state: the mission's ball has been picked up and the episode ends. No further objective; the reward machine stays in u5 for any remaining steps.
